info.title: v2.shop.get_br_shop_onboarding_info
info.description: [For BR Shop Only] Use this API to get shop KYC registration and qualification information.

get.description: [For BR Shop Only] Use this API to get shop KYC registration and qualification information.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/shop/get_br_shop_onboarding_info?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: error
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate error type if hit error. Empty if no error happened.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: message
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate error details if hit error. Empty if no error happened.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: request_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The identifier for an API request for error tracking.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: response
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Onboarding information of the Shop.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: tax_id_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Type of the shop’s tax ID. Applicable values: 1: Personal seller (CPF) 2: Company seller (CNPJ)

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: tax_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The shop’s tax ID. - When tax_id_type = 1 (Personal seller), it is CPF. - When tax_id_type = 2 (Company seller), it is CNPJ.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: cpf_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: CPF number of the individual seller. Valid only when tax_id_type = 1.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: cnpj_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: CNPJ number of the company seller. Valid only when tax_id_type = 2.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Full name of the individual seller. Valid only when tax_id_type = 1.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: legal_entity_name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Legal name of the company seller. Valid only when tax_id_type = 2.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: birthday
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Birthday of the individual seller (stored as Unix timestamp). Valid only when tax_id_type = 1.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: birthday_str
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Birthday of the individual seller (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). Valid only when tax_id_type = 1.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: state_registration
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: State registration number of the shop.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: billing_address
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Shop’s billing address details.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: state
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: State of the billing address.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: city
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: City of the billing address.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: address
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Specific detail of the billing address.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: zipcode
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: ZIP code of the billing address.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: neighborhood
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Neighborhood of the billing address.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: onboarding_status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Status of the shop’s current KYC onboarding process. Applicable values: 0: None 1: Regis Processing 2: Regis Validated 3: Regis Rejected 4: KYC Pending 5: KYC Processing 6: KYC Processing Manually 7: KYC Validated 8: KYC Rejected

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: submission_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Timestamp when the onboarding information was submitted.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: nationality
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Nationality of the individual seller. Valid only when tax_id_type=1.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: cnae_main
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Main CNAE code.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: cnae_secondary
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Secondary CNAE code.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: mei_check
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: MEI verification result. Applicable values: 0: No 1: Yes

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: onboarding_passed
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicate if the shop has passed KYC verification.
